summary: The Environmental Research & Education Foundation tallied open U.S. landfills for a report last month. It also previewed new data on where municipal solid waste is going during a panel at RCon.

title: Casella mulls options after early landfill closure announcement
summary: The decision to close its Bethlehem, New Hampshire, landfill a year early comes with capacity and logistics concerns in a state where residents have long protested Casella’s landfill expansion attempts.

title: American Battery granted export license for $100M in black mass
summary: The permit allows ABTC to continue operations at its critical mineral recycling facility. The company says battery collection and shredding infrastructure has developed faster than domestic downstream refining capacity.

title: Casella landfills expanding in NY, closing in NH; Chiquita Canyon audit
summary: Casella is expanding a New York landfill and closing a New Hampshire landfill early. California auditors this week gave L.A. County health regulators low marks on their Chiquita Canyon landfill response.

title: Phone recycling changes could spur $2.2B in critical minerals recovery
summary: An Ellen MacArthur Foundation report calls for better phone design, repair options, recycling infrastructure and secondary processing locations, but opportunities are uneven.

title: Federal EPR could cut waste management costs in half: WWF
summary: Producer compliance costs could be roughly halved by following one framework instead of individual states’ EPR laws, according to an economic analysis from World Wildlife Fund and SC Johnson.

title: Blue Sage Capital plans to run the Frontier Waste playbook in Midwest
summary: The Texas-based private equity firm is looking to repeat prior success with the launch of Blue Castle Waste Solutions. The regional hauler has closed three acquisitions in Iowa and Minnesota so far.

title: EFS, Merlin, GreenWaste, Valemi get flex film recycling contracts
summary: The US Flexible Film Initiative says it has moved more than 3 million pounds of flexible plastic packaging from California collection programs to reclaimers in the U.S. and Canada for processing.

title: California approves labor-backed force majeure updates and other laws
summary: Gov. Newsom signed a union-backed bill updating hauler franchise labor rules a few years after vetoing a similar bill. He also approved bills related to carpet recycling, bottle bill fees and food waste prevention.

title: Newsom signs law banning single-use vapes that pose fire risk
